templates.description_logique: Aucune valeur nulle ou vide sur la colonne ciblee
templates.question_metier: Which information must never be missing?
templates.explication: The control fails when rows carry no value in that column.
templates.exemple_metier: Every trade must carry an amount.
templates.phrase: Column “{column}” must be filled in on every row.
templates.phrase_role: Every “{role}” field must be filled in.

params_libelles.column: Column that must always be filled

templates.description_logique: La valeur respecte une expression reguliere
templates.question_metier: Which format must this information follow?
templates.explication: The control fails when a value does not match the expected format.
templates.exemple_metier: A currency code is exactly three capital letters, such as EUR or USD.

templates.description_logique: La valeur appartient a une liste fermee
templates.libelle_metier: Must belong to an allowed list
templates.question_metier: Which values are the only ones accepted?
templates.explication: The control fails as soon as a value falls outside the list.
templates.exemple_metier: A contract type can only be Permanent, Fixed-term or Intern.

templates.description_logique: La valeur numerique est comprise dans l'intervalle
templates.question_metier: Between which values must this number stay?
templates.explication: The control fails when a number falls outside the range. Empty cells are ignored.
templates.phrase_min: Column “{column}” must be greater than or equal to {min}.
templates.phrase_max: Column “{column}” must be less than or equal to {max}.

templates.description_logique: Aucun doublon sur la cle composee
templates.question_metier: What must be unique in the file?
templates.explication: The control fails when two rows carry the same value.
templates.exemple_metier: The same invoice number cannot appear twice.
templates.phrase: No two rows may share the same “{columns}”.

params_libelles.columns: Column(s) that identify a row uniquely

templates.description_logique: Toute valeur existe dans le referentiel cible (integrite referentielle)
templates.libelle_metier: Must exist in a reference table
templates.question_metier: Which code must a reference table recognise?
templates.explication: The control fails when a code in the file cannot be found in the reference table.
templates.exemple_metier: Every currency quoted must appear in the currency reference table.
templates.phrase: Every “{column}” must exist in reference table “{ref_dataset}”.

params_libelles.ref_dataset: Reference table to attach it to
params_libelles.ref_column: Column of the reference table holding the code

templates.description_logique: Deux champs portent la meme valeur
templates.question_metier: Which two columns must carry the same value?
templates.explication: The control fails when the two columns diverge.
templates.exemple_metier: The total shown at the foot of the file must equal the computed total.
templates.phrase: “{field_a}” and “{field_b}” must carry the same value.

templates.description_logique: La date 'before' est anterieure ou egale a la date 'after'
templates.question_metier: Which date must come before the other?
templates.explication: The control fails when the two dates are the wrong way round.
templates.exemple_metier: A start date always precedes an end date.

templates.description_logique: L'observation la plus recente date de moins de N jours
templates.question_metier: How old may the data be?
templates.explication: The control fails when the most recent record is too old.
templates.exemple_metier: A file refreshed monthly must not be older than 45 days.
templates.phrase: The most recent “{column}” must be less than {max_lag_days} days old.

templates.description_logique: Compare un total declare a la somme de ses composantes. sens = parties_max | couverture_min | bilateral
templates.question_metier: Which total must match the sum of its parts?
templates.explication: The control compares a total row against the sum of its components and reports the gaps.
templates.exemple_metier: Revenue for “all regions” must equal the sum of the regions.
templates.phrase: Total “{total_value}” of “{total_column}” must match the sum of “{amount}”.

params_libelles.group_by: Dimensions to hold fixed when comparing
params_libelles.sens: What counts as an unacceptable gap

templates.phrase_parties_max: The sum of “{amount}” must never exceed total “{total_value}”.
templates.phrase_couverture_min: The breakdown of “{amount}” must cover at least {couverture_min_pct} % of total “{total_value}”.

templates.description_logique: Le nombre de lignes concorde avec le dataset de reference
templates.libelle_metier: Must have the right number of rows
templates.question_metier: Which file must the row count match?
templates.explication: The control fails when the two files hold different numbers of rows.
templates.exemple_metier: After a transfer, the file received must hold as many rows as the file sent.
templates.phrase: The number of rows must match that of “{ref_dataset}”.

templates.description_logique: Expression pandas evaluee ligne a ligne ; doit etre vraie partout
templates.question_metier: Which condition must hold on every row?
templates.explication: For technical users only: the condition is written in pandas syntax and evaluated row by row.

controls.description: Every published observation must carry an amount.
controls.logic_definition: Column “turnover_notionnel” must be filled in on every row.
controls.remediation_action: Reject the publication and request a fresh extract from the BIS source.

controls.description: Every identifier declared in a file contract must be filled in.
controls.logic_definition: Every “identifier” field must be filled in.
controls.remediation_action: Block the load; the identifier is rebuilt during preparation.

controls.control_name: Notional amount must not be negative
controls.description: A notional turnover cannot be negative.
controls.logic_definition: Column “turnover_notionnel” must be greater than or equal to 0.
controls.remediation_action: Escalate to the Market Data Office; check the sign at the source.

controls.control_name: Reporting basis must be a known code
controls.description: The basis must be A (gross), B (net) or C (net-net).
controls.logic_definition: Column “DER_BASIS” may only contain: A, B, C.
controls.remediation_action: Fix the code mapping at ingestion.

controls.description: A currency code is three capital letters, or TO1 for the “all currencies” aggregate.
controls.remediation_action: Normalise the code, or add it to the reference table once arbitrated.

controls.description: The year must fall inside the period the survey covers.
controls.remediation_action: Extend the upper bound with each new survey wave.

controls.description: No declared primary key may appear twice.
controls.remediation_action: De-duplicate during preparation and log the row that was dropped.

controls.description: Every currency quoted must exist in the currency reference table.
controls.logic_definition: Every “DER_CURR_LEG1” must exist in reference table “ref_devises”.
controls.remediation_action: Data Steward arbitration: enrich the reference table or reject the row.

controls.description: Every currency quoted must exist in the currency reference table.
controls.logic_definition: Every “DER_CURR_LEG2” must exist in reference table “ref_devises”.
controls.remediation_action: Data Steward arbitration: enrich the reference table or reject the row.

controls.description: Every reporting country must exist in the country reference table.
controls.logic_definition: Every “DER_REP_CTY” must exist in reference table “ref_pays”.
controls.remediation_action: Data Steward arbitration: enrich the reference table or reject the row.

controls.description: An FX trade cannot carry the same currency on both legs.
controls.params: {"expression": "(DER_CURR_LEG1 != DER_CURR_LEG2) or (DER_CURR_LEG1 == 'TO1')", "description_metier": "Hors totaux, les deux jambes different"}
controls.logic_definition: Every row must satisfy: (DER_CURR_LEG1 != DER_CURR_LEG2) or (DER_CURR_LEG1 == 'TO1').
controls.remediation_action: Check the pair at the source; reclassify as a total if it is an aggregate.

controls.description: The most recent observation must be less than four years old.
controls.logic_definition: The most recent “date_observation” must be less than 1460 days old.
controls.remediation_action: Trigger the load of the next survey wave.

controls.control_name: Country breakdown must not exceed the total
controls.description: The sum of reporting countries can never exceed the “all zones” total. Exceeding it signals double counting or an aggregation error.
controls.logic_definition: The sum of “turnover_notionnel” must never exceed total “5J”.
controls.remediation_action: Blocking: investigate double counting with the Market Data Office before publication.

controls.control_name: Currency reference must carry a label
controls.description: Every currency code carries a usable label.
controls.logic_definition: Column “libelle_devise” must be filled in on every row.
controls.remediation_action: Fill the label from the ISO 4217 source.

controls.description: Annual threshold abandoned: the BIS survey is triennial.
controls.logic_definition: The most recent “date_observation” must be less than 365 days old.

controls.description: The published country breakdown must cover at least 95 % of the world total. Below that, geographic analysis is not usable.
controls.logic_definition: The breakdown of “turnover_notionnel” must cover at least 95 % of total “5J”.
controls.remediation_action: Document the unpublished jurisdictions in the methodological note accompanying the release.

controls.logic_definition: Column “annee” must be filled in on every row.
